openQuestions.question: No item in the app for this STM (NO ITEM): itemCode set to the STM number STM-RM-077. Confirm the item before loading.

The STM is titled 'Methylene blue' but every test, reference and limit in it is for Natural Beta carotene 20 % (inhouse specifications, USP references, Analytical Method Validation Report for Natural beta carotene 20 %). No methylene blue test or limit can be confirmed, so no grades, rows or tests are loaded. The micro limits in the text (TAMC NMT 10^3 CFU/gm, TYMC NMT 10^2 CFU/gm, E. coli and Salmonella absent /10 gm) are also held back for the same reason. Confirm the correct STM text.

openQuestions.question: The spec sheet in this folder is for Magnesium Oxide (STM-RM-058, item codes VB010100100038, VB010121800016), not Methylene Blue. Misfiled; ignored, not used for specFiles.
Revision history says the STM code changed from C5I-91-212 to 'STM-SM-102', which does not match STM-RM-077.

Minimum sample quantity (50 g routine and retention, 100 g periodic retest) comes from the same beta carotene text; loaded because it is a plain statement in section 7, but confirm it applies to methylene blue.
